reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-23. SG-FORGE's product page states "Your assets are 100% backed by cash, ensuring immediate liquidity" and shows "Last update 23/08/2026" with "BNY : 89.63% | Societe Generale : 10.37%" for USD CoinVertible. The page also shows USD 11,000,000.00 and USD 1,272,441.00 against USD 12,272,441.00 in circulation; the percentages sum to 100.00%. The current white paper identifies BNY as The Bank of New York Mellon SA/NV and says the issuer may use additional segregated accounts, so the disclosed allocation is recorded as two bank-deposit slices. No maturity maximum is authored because neither source states one.
